principles: Match the product job and visual quality before matching geography, popularity, or market proximity.
Official product pages are stronger sources for product storytelling than generic inspiration galleries.
Use one source for object and brand narrative, another for feature proof or workflow, and a third only when it adds a distinct material, technical, or commerce lens.
A source is a candidate until its live page is inspected; the catalog never proves that a site is current or good for the target product.
